items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: I did a lot of those Phil Spector dates where he had five bass players.

ctx.x: And I guess I’m wondering how they continued to do it, contrasting with the fact that you said this is not for me anymore? I guess I don’t expect you to speak for them but perhaps it’s a financial consideration or that they had enough other things on the side that kept them creatively happy.

There were several of us that did the same thing at different times I’ve read about later. I mean I used to be on dates with Barney Kessel and I heard that he said, “Oh F this” and stopped. And Carol Kaye — I used to be on dates with her. And I did a lot of those Phil Spector dates where he had five bass players. You know. Absurd.
I’ve never understood how could that possibly work? Did he have someone write out the bass lines so that everybody was playing the same thing?
